title: The Re-embedding and Backfill Playbook: Visual Guide
outline: Title: The Re-embedding and Backfill Playbook: Visual Guide

1. Rebuild Beside And Swap | three build strategies (mutate v3 in place, build v4 from the old index, build v4 beside from the lake) with a staleness-replay toggle, showing rollback, propagation and error-inheritance | build beside and move a versioned alias in one atomic operation, read from the source of truth so defects are not photocopied, and replay the snapshot gap before the swap

2. The Four Gates | four validation gates (structural, golden set, shadow traffic, canary soak) switched on and off against six real defects | the gates are ordered cheapest-first and each catches a different class, so a green golden set alone still lets cold-cache timeouts and rare ACL shapes reach users

3. Sizing The Shadow | traffic volume, shadow percentage and soak duration dialled against a query class that is 3% of traffic, plus a top-10 overlap slider | a shadow is evidence only if it contains the class you fear for a full traffic cycle, and overlap must never be 100% but every delta has to be explained

4. Full Or Incremental | seven changes from the trigger table tapped to show blast radius, documents touched and cost, plus a re-run button with idempotency on or off | full backfill when every artifact changes and incremental when a subset does, and replay must be idempotent because retries are the steady state

5. Rollback And Mixing | a clock from cutover to 336 hours against a 168-hour rollback window, plus three change types judged for mixed-version safety | inside the window rollback is an alias move in seconds and outside it is a rebuild in hours, and only metadata-only backfills may mix generations
